'''Riv Garbi''' was a great [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] and [[Author/Legends|author]]. Around roughly [[3630 BBY]],it was rumored that one of his long-lost texts was discovered on his home planet in a private collection.<ref name="Pages">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Pages of the Past}}</ref>
